Vanessa / Ben — reviewed the baseline and ProcureCo checklist. High-level legal guidance: 

1) PO acceptance / auto-accept: Accepting POs automatically based solely on schema match carries a modest operational risk (price/quantity mismatch edge cases). Proposed compromise: auto-accept when a PO matches previously agreed SKU catalog + price hash; otherwise move to "pending acceptance" with a 3-business-day review SLA. Suggested clause: 

"If the Supplier's system validates the Purchase Order against the Supplier's published SKU catalog and the price hash, the Purchase Order will be deemed accepted upon validation. For POs that fail validation, Supplier will provide written acceptance or rejection within three (3) business days."

2) Data retention: ensure our retention policy mirrors customer expectations (ProcureCo asked about audit logs); agree to 90 days for transactional payloads unless otherwise requested in writing.

3) Indemnity / liability cap: redlines attached — we should keep Redwood's liability limited to fees paid for the affected order in the prior 12 months.

I attached detailed comments in MSA_redline_comments.docx. Ben — once you confirm the fields you will send, I can draft a single short addendum for the order form with the acceptance language and sample field map.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
